name: PDF RAG Assistant
description: A Flask-based RAG application that allows users to ask questions about uploaded PDF documents.
features: LLM-powered question answering using retrieved document context
technical_workflow: Extract content from uploaded PDF documents.
Split the extracted content into chunks.
Store the embeddings in a FAISS vector index.
Retrieve relevant document chunks for a user query.
Use an LLM through Ollama to generate an answer from the retrieved context.
role: Designed and developed the RAG pipeline and Flask-based application.
